title: t4imgs_4dfp
description: Freesurfer tool for transforming images according to a specified T4 file.

sqrt_normalize.description: Normalize by sqrt(n) rather than n (for z images).
sqrt_normalize.title: Sqrt Normalize Flag

cubic_spline.description: Interpolate by 3D cubic spline (default is 3D linear).
cubic_spline.title: Cubic Spline Interpolation Flag

output_111_space.description: Output in 111 space instead of default 333.0 space.
output_111_space.title: Output 111 Space Flag

output_222_space.description: Output in 222 space instead of default 333.0 space.
output_222_space.title: Output 222 Space Flag

output_333n_space.description: Output in 333.n space (y shifted up by n pixels).
output_333n_space.title: Output 333.n Space

output_image.description: Output file name for the transformed image.
output_image.title: Output Image
